reviewedRevision: 416d939 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-wave shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its MEDIUM blind-play finding and a level 17 difficulty spike were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot script, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round. The coordinator localised the level-select tier labels found untranslated in the browser check.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's blind patterns (hold Space facing Up, 1 s shield pulses with a rotating facing, and facing sweeps at 1.6, 2, 2.4 and 3 s periods) cleared 0 of 6 runs on every level from 3 to 20, and 0 of 12 on level 17. The reviewer's reaction-limited bot (public getState only, 60 Hz) cleared every level at 0.25 s (at least 3 of 4 seeds, levels 17 and 19 at 3 of 4) and at 0.35 s cleared mastery levels 15-20 in 46 of 48 runs, with average lowest HP 1.5-3.0 on mastery against 3.9-5 on levels 1-14. In the review round final states matched across 30, 60 and 120 Hz, a 400 s hostile fuzz ended exactly once with no NaN, broken progress stores were safe, lances gave 1 s and slams 1.3 s of warning, and an idle player lost no HP in the first 4 s of level 1.

findings.observation: Only 3 waves and a Guardian, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven levels (teaching 1-7, combination 8-14, mastery 15-20, five Guardian levels) with orbs, slugs, lances, crawlers and slams, accurate EN/ZH tips, a level select and env.progress continue; telegraphs carry text labels (ORB, SLUG, LANCE, SLAM), bash presses are latched, and the 1,144-line file is split into six modules.

Review finding: holding the shield facing Up beat level 7 (Stone Warden) 20 of 20, and a slow facing sweep beat level 4 (Crawler Hatch) 20 of 20 at a 2 s period. The level 7 guardian now has 8 HP and two slams, level 4's second turret moved to the right wall with five crawlers, and level 12 and 17 shooters were adjusted so no fixed facing covers them.

Verification finding: level 17 (Swarm) was a spike, clearing 3 of 8 for the reviewer's bot at 0.35 s while its neighbours cleared 7-8 of 8. Its rests, shot speeds and crawler pressure were eased; it now clears 8 of 8 while still costing more HP than level 14 (average lowest HP 1.88 against 3.88).
Browser finding: in Chinese the level-select cells showed the English tier tag (TEACH). The tags are now bilingual (教学, 组合, 精通).

openNotes: Levels 1-3 can be won by holding the shield, and a state-aware hold-only player still clears levels 4, 6 and 8; blind play stays at 0% from level 3.
Levels 1-11 cost a good player almost no HP; the curve steepens from level 15.
The reviewer's bot did not finish a full 1-20 campaign in one run (2 HP heal per level); levels are meant to be played from the select.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the language toggle, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened level 1 of 20 (First Reflection) with HP, shield and bash meters and a tip banner that does not cover the sentinel or the turret.
Win: holding Space reflected the orbs, cleared level 1 and advanced to level 2 of 20 with the score shown.

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the level select showed level 1 cleared and 2 unlocked, with touch buttons 左, 上, 下, 右, 举盾（按住） and 重击; after the label fix the cells read 教学.
Not covered in the browser: a loss and a Guardian level; the reviewer's bot and the quality tests cover them.
